annotations.text:
CHH-F06 — Emergency Services Hub (CHH-68; US-CHH-001-01/02/03)
Mobile row above, web row below. Every screen ships both, per design/ui-standard.md Breakpoints.
Built from the CHH-F06 Confluence spec: §1 Feature Overview, §2 Data Dictionary, §3 the three user stories.

Decisions carried from the draft:
1. CATEGORY IS A SEGMENTED CONTROL, NOT A DROPDOWN. The Data Dictionary calls service_cat a dropdown; ui-standard.md §Select says 2–4 mutually exclusive options take a segmented control. Three options — All · Hospitals · Ambulances — with All as the spec's default.
2. Only Verified facilities appear (§4 Question 1, answered). Every card carries a Verified pill so the rule is visible rather than implied, and both empty states say so in words.
3. The hub is the EMERGENCY register (ui-standard.md §Design direction): the call action is 54px, one per screen, and it is the only red thing on the detail screen. List cards carry no call button — the card opens the detail, so red stays a signal.
4. Facility distance is EXACT (2.4 km), unlike a donor alert's "about 5 km". The off-app approximation rule protects an individual's location; a hospital is a public organisation with a published address.
5. Web is a two-pane layout — filters and results on the left, map with numbered pins on the right — not the phone stretched wide. Facility details is a MODAL over that (spec UI Note: "modal or a separate screen"); mobile gets the separate screen.
6. Guest state is shown, not assumed away: a guest chip in the web top bar and one inline alert on mobile saying search and call are open to everyone but requesting blood needs a verified number (§1).

HOW STATES ARE DRAWN (same convention as CHH-F03/F04/F05)
Each artboard carries one AC-state tweak chip rather than a separate file per state.

HubSearch — hospitals (AC1) | ambulances (AC1, other category) | nameSearch (AC2) | loading (skeletons, ui-standard.md §Loaders: never a bare full-screen spinner)
HubSearchWeb — results (AC3 proximity) | nameSearch (AC2) | gpsDenied (edge case: alphabetical fallback, no distance claimed, banner explains why)
HubFacilityDetails — contacts (AC1/AC2) | noContacts (edge case: primary facility number shown, and the sticky action renames itself to say who it dials)
HubEmptyStates — noResults (001-03 AC1) | gpsDenied (001-03 AC2, manual city entry with suggestions) | error (load failure with retry)
HubEmptyStatesWeb — noResults | error

Static artboard: HubFacilityDetailsWeb (the modal, contacts present). Renamed with a Hub- prefix to avoid a filename collision with the existing CHH-F03 FacilityDetails.dc.html (Facility Registration Step 1) already on the canonical canvas.

AC3 proximity sorting is drawn twice on purpose: the mobile board states it in the sort line, the web board shows it as ordered numbered pins so the ordering is legible rather than asserted.

STILL OPEN — the spec does not decide these, so they are flagged, not invented.

• §4 Question 2 (search radius limit) is Open. The frames show a "Within" control defaulting to 15 km with the empty state offering a widen action; if the answer is a fixed radius, the control goes and the copy changes.
• "Max 100 chars / Search term too long" (Data Dictionary) has no artboard — a 100-character query does not fit a phone search field visibly, so it needs a decision: hard input cap, or an error under the field. Not drawn either way.
• Map view: the spec's AC3 says "integrated map view or external map app". The web board draws an in-page map; mobile draws a static preview whose button hands off to the OS map app. If the integrated map is required on mobile too, that is another artboard.
• Facility opening hours are shown as a pill on ambulance cards ("Open 24 hours") but are NOT in the Data Dictionary. Either add the field to the spec or the pill comes out.
• Whether the hub appears in the guest bottom navigation at all, and what the other guest tabs are, is a role-matrix question for the PRD; the nav drawn here is a placeholder with Emergency active.

NOT DRAWN: the map-pin-to-card interaction on web beyond selection, saved/recent searches, and any per-facility inventory (that is CHH-F07 territory, not this story).
